prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE reusable transparent tunnel-section sprite for a first-person medieval dungeon game, landscape 16:9.

Transform the supplied tomb concept (image 1) into a SINGLE HOLLOW CROSS-SECTION of the same tomb: stone ceiling across the top, solid masonry left and right walls, and flagstone floor across the bottom. This is one foreground surround through which the viewer looks, a physical architectural slice, not a complete corridor picture. Image 2 is the approved ink/colour style reference.

COMPOSITION IS CRITICAL: one continuous border of ceiling, walls and floor around a VERY LARGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT opening. The opening occupies about 56% of the image width and 62% of its height, centered, with a gently arched upper boundary, near-vertical sides, and flat lower edge. It is a truly empty alpha hole, absolutely no black fill, no paper fill, no checkerboard drawn in it, no scenery through it. The outer masonry reaches every canvas edge, fully opaque. The walls are roughly 22% width each, floor 18% height, vaulted ceiling 20%. Show a little depth on the inner stone faces and floor slabs directed toward the center, but only ONE arch/cross-section. There are NO nested arches, no distant corridor, no far wall, no door. We will repeat this exact sprite at decreasing scales in code to construct the tunnel.

Art: match the supplied tomb masonry and original game concept closely: confident irregular black woodcut contours, fine carved crosshatching and sparse chips/cracks, warm pale parchment stone, slightly grubby medieval handmade print. Similar detail density to concept, not simplistic blocks, not photographic stone. Mostly pale parchment and black ink, restrained warm grey/brown shadows, no yellow blanket tint, no glossy finish. Crisp cutout edges, solid opaque stone interiors; no smoke, mist, blur, gradient shading or edge halos. Use carved ink shading.
Remove all figures, skeletons, portraits, UI, numbers, writing, torches, coffins and props. Output ONLY the hollow stone section with its large transparent central aperture. No frame outside the architectural structure.
cleanup: prepare-slice.py: no redraw, RGB unchanged except fully transparent fringe; near-opaque masonry made fully solid.
